name: HTML Entity Encode / Decode
summary: Escape or unescape HTML entities (&, <, numeric codes) — locally in your browser.
description: Encode special characters for safe HTML embedding, optionally turning non-ASCII into decimal or hex numeric entities. Decode named and numeric entities back to text. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: Which characters are escaped by default?
Can I encode emoji and accents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enable “Encode non-ASCII” to emit &#…; or &#x…; entities.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Encoding and decoding run entirely in your browser.
